## Physical model

Fill in when a physical model is added or changed; otherwise mark not applicable.

- [ ] Not applicable
- [ ] Reference with edition and equation or section in a `References:` docstring section
- [ ] Assumptions, valid range and permissible uses documented; out-of-range use warns or raises
- [ ] Inputs and outputs documented in SI
- [ ] Verification test against an exact or manufactured solution (observed order of accuracy for discretized methods)
- [ ] Comparison against an independent reference
- [ ] Invariant tests (conservation, non-negativity, monotonicity)
- [ ] Validation status stated: measured data used, or "verified, not validated"
- [ ] Calibrated parameters marked with their source data
